forecast.seedPolicy: fixed-per-game: hash(providerEventId); draw i uses mulberry32(fnv1a32(seed + ':' + i))

engine.structure: shared-pace team scoring → quarter split → overtime → player allocation
engine.seedPolicy: fixed-per-game: hash(providerEventId); draw i uses mulberry32(fnv1a32(seed + ':' + i))
engine.otCapRule: at most 8 OT periods; a tied 8th period is redrawn until untied (rejection, counted in notes.otCapRedraws)

sim.tieRule: overtime resolves every regulation tie (5-minute periods until untied; cap rule in engine.otCapRule)

representativeSamples.label: typical
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw minimising ((margin−p50 margin)/sd margin)² + ((total−p50 total)/sd total)²; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: close
representativeSamples.selectionRule: among draws with the smallest |final margin| (1), the one whose total is nearest p50 total; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: high
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose total is nearest the 95th-percentile total (264), then margin nearest p50 margin; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: low
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose total is nearest the 5th-percentile total (204), then margin nearest p50 margin; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: upset
representativeSamples.selectionRule: the sim underdog (away, pHome 0.6423) wins in 3577 draws; among them, the draw nearest their median (margin, total) in sd units; ties → lowest runIndex
